cases.title: Packet contains no note or assignment executor
cases.detail: decideFixedMessageHandoff returns a customer message and never posts a note or an assignment. The required order cannot be enforced.
cases.expected: note success, then assign success, then fixed message
cases.actual: action fixed_message or allow, with no handoff operations

cases.title: Fixed message is returned when note and assign have not succeeded
cases.detail: noteOk, assignOk, and handoffSucceeded are ignored. teamAssigneeId is ignored.
cases.expected: no customer message
cases.actual: Hello Synthetic, how can I help?

cases.title: English substantive account question does not take the fixed welcome
cases.expected: allow, message null

cases.title: Short account-number ask plus a live-agent phrase still sends the fixed message
cases.detail: Non-latin characters and the live-agent phrase are stripped. A short remainder is classified as vague, so an account-number question becomes a customer message with no handoff.
cases.expected: no customer message before identity handling and a successful handoff
cases.actual: fixed_message Hello, how can I help?

cases.title: Urdu fixed message is in that language and is not sent before handoff success
cases.detail: Urdu handoff ask does not select a Urdu fixed message. The gate stays closed, so this is a language gap, not a premature send.
cases.expected: withhold until note then assign succeed; message in Urdu

cases.title: Arabic fixed message is in that language and is not sent before handoff success
cases.detail: Arabic handoff ask does not select a Arabic fixed message. The gate stays closed, so this is a language gap, not a premature send.
cases.expected: withhold until note then assign succeed; message in Arabic

cases.title: Hindi fixed message is in that language and is not sent before handoff success
cases.detail: Hindi handoff ask does not select a Hindi fixed message. The gate stays closed, so this is a language gap, not a premature send.
cases.expected: withhold until note then assign succeed; message in Hindi

cases.title: Urdu account-number question must not emit a premature or English-only fixed message
cases.detail: Script other than Latin is removed before the vagueness length check, so the account question collapses into a live-agent welcome.
cases.expected: no customer message
cases.actual: fixed_message السلام علیکم، میں آپ کی کیا مدد کر سکتا ہوں؟

cases.title: Arabic account-number question must not emit a premature or English-only fixed message
cases.detail: Script other than Latin is removed before the vagueness length check, so the account question collapses into a live-agent welcome.
cases.expected: no customer message
cases.actual: fixed_message السلام علیکم، میں آپ کی کیا مدد کر سکتا ہوں؟

cases.title: Hindi account-number question must not emit a premature or English-only fixed message
cases.detail: Script other than Latin is removed before the vagueness length check, so the account question collapses into a live-agent welcome.
cases.expected: no customer message
cases.actual: fixed_message Hello, how can I help?

cases.title: Risk ownership is not visible to the packet, so a Risk conversation still gets a fixed message
cases.expected: silence
cases.actual: fixed_message السلام علیکم، میں آپ کی کیا مدد کر سکتا ہوں؟

cases.title: Ambiguous teammate author type fails open and the fixed message is released
cases.detail: Author type teammate is not admin, so humanTeammateAlreadyRepliedPublic is false. Missing part_type is also ignored. The packet then sends.
cases.expected: silence

cases.title: Fixed welcome text does not echo a synthetic credential
cases.detail: No customer message was produced: the credential made the remainder after live-agent stripping longer than 28 characters, so the gate closed. The welcome builder also does not interpolate client text. This does not show that a note would redact the credential.
cases.expected: secret absent from the customer message

cases.title: Urdu and Hindi given names survive in the fixed greeting
cases.detail: firstNameFromClient keeps only Latin-1 letters, so Urdu, Arabic, and Hindi names are dropped.
cases.expected: names retained
cases.actual: {"urduGreeting":"السلام علیکم، میں آپ کی کیا مدد کر سکتا ہوں؟","hindiGreeting":"Hello, how can I help?"}

cases.title: Author packet tests were not used as acceptance
cases.detail: The 16 author tests were not executed and are not evidence. They pin the copied welcome gate; they do not cover note, assign, failure, replay, credentials, or ownership.
cases.expected: not used

cases.title: identity-recovery promise is posted before note and assignment
cases.detail: In the source window, postClientCommentOnce is at offset 223, note at 1045, assign at 1334. Assignment failure is only logged.
cases.expected: note, then assign, then customer message, and only after both succeed

cases.title: main escalate promise is posted before note and assignment
cases.detail: In the source window, postClientCommentOnce is at offset 208, note at 995, assign at 1272. Assignment failure is only logged.
cases.expected: note, then assign, then customer message, and only after both succeed

cases.title: main escalate promise is posted before note and assignment
cases.detail: In the source window, postClientCommentOnce is at offset 226, note at 987, assign at 1288. Assignment failure is only logged.
cases.expected: note, then assign, then customer message, and only after both succeed

cases.title: main escalate promise is posted before note and assignment
cases.detail: In the source window, postClientCommentOnce is at offset 142, note at 905, assign at 1045. Assignment failure is only logged.
cases.expected: note, then assign, then customer message, and only after both succeed

cases.title: Fin handoff welcome is a customer send with no note and no assignment
cases.detail: The gate at the FIN_HANDOFF_WELCOME log posts lockedFinHandoffWelcome and returns. No note or assignment is attempted.
cases.expected: no customer message until note and assign succeed

cases.title: Awaiting-teammate state is set even when assignment fails
cases.detail: After ESCALATE_ASSIGN_FAILED is logged, the same block still sets escalateAwaitingFirstTeammate. A later related turn can send a status line that says the team already has the case.
cases.expected: awaiting flag only after assign succeeds
cases.actual: flag is set after a failed or skipped assign as long as the note returned ok

cases.title: Human assignment does not by itself silence a live-agent ask
cases.detail: The last return in shouldDeferToHumanTeammate is skip false. A non-greeting live-agent ask still falls through when a human is assigned or has already replied, unless a narrower external-handoff rule matches. The welcome gate then runs.
cases.expected: silence on human-owned conversations
cases.actual: defer returns skip false and the welcome gate can send

cases.title: Welcome path sends a customer message with no note and no assignment
cases.expected: no customer message before note and assign succeed
cases.detail: Executed handleWebhook. FIN_HANDOFF welcome path.

cases.title: Risk teambox stays silent for an Urdu live-agent ask
cases.expected: no customer message
cases.detail: Exact Risk team id returns through the silent note path before the welcome gate.

cases.title: Escalations teambox stays silent for an Arabic live-agent ask
cases.expected: no customer message
cases.detail: Exact Escalations team id is silent before the welcome gate.

cases.title: Hindi live-agent ask on a Risk teambox stays silent
cases.expected: no customer message
cases.detail: Language does not bypass the Risk return.

cases.title: Human-assigned conversation still receives the fixed welcome
cases.expected: silence
cases.detail: admin_assignee_id 424242 is a human seat. shouldDeferToHumanTeammate does not skip this live-agent ask, and the welcome gate does not read assignment.

cases.title: Ambiguous admin part shape fails open into the fixed welcome
cases.expected: silence when ownership shape is ambiguous
cases.detail: The admin body has no part_type, so it is not treated as a human reply.

cases.title: Identity recovery sends the customer promise before note and assignment
cases.expected: note, assign, then message; secret absent from every write
cases.actual: order comment,note,assignment, secretInComment false, secretInNote true
cases.detail: Customer comment is first (index.js:3684). The note keeps the synthetic credential because sanitizeEscalateProblem (index.js:545) never calls credentialSanitizer. The customer comment does not echo it.

cases.title: Assignment HTTP 500 still leaves the customer promise already sent
cases.expected: no customer message when assign returns 500
cases.actual: order comment,note,assignment, noteStatus 200, assignStatus 500, secretInComment false, secretInNote true
cases.detail: Main escalate path. HTTP 500 on assignment is stored as unknown and is not success. The customer comment was already accepted.

cases.title: Assignment timeout is an unknown outcome and the promise was already sent
cases.expected: no customer message when assignment times out
cases.detail: icRequest reports the assignment as unknown and does not retry it. The customer write already happened.

cases.title: Note failure still follows a customer promise
cases.expected: no customer message when the note is rejected
cases.detail: Note 422 happens after the customer comment. Assignment is then skipped, awaiting is not marked, and the promise remains.

cases.title: Substantive English account question does not take the fixed welcome
cases.expected: no fixed welcome
cases.detail: Model call is blocked in this case, so a later escalate is not executed. The welcome gate itself did not send.

cases.title: Urdu account question mixed with a live-agent phrase takes the fixed welcome
cases.expected: no fixed welcome for an account-number question
cases.detail: Same vagueness collapse as the packet. The runtime welcome path sends. arabic-script here is the existing Urdu welcome line.

cases.title: Hindi account question mixed with a live-agent phrase is not served in Hindi
cases.expected: no English fixed welcome
cases.detail: Devanagari is stripped by the vagueness check and is not a branch in lockedFinHandoffWelcome. A latin script class means the English welcome was the customer message.

cases.title: Stale refetch of the same welcome does not place a second identical write
cases.detail: The second webhook still sees the original parts. writeOpStore suppresses the identical comment because the first write was confirmed. This does not fix the first premature send.
cases.expected: one customer write, replay suppressed

cases.title: A timed-out welcome is not replayed
cases.detail: The timeout is stored as unknown and a later identical write is suppressed. The customer may or may not have received the first message. There is still no note or assignment on this path.
cases.expected: no second write after an unknown outcome

cases.title: A second webhook while the first is in flight does not send another welcome
cases.detail: clientReplyInflight skips the overlapping delivery. The first delivery still sends the welcome with no handoff.
cases.expected: one customer write

cases.title: Partial success marks the case awaiting a teammate after a rejected assignment
cases.expected: awaiting flag clear when assign is rejected
cases.detail: 422 assignee_not_found is a failed assignment. The customer promise was already sent and the awaiting flag is still set.

cases.title: Runtime mirror state stayed under the synthetic temp directory
cases.detail: Control, ticket, and write-op files were isolated. No production state path was used.
cases.expected: /tmp
